. Często wracam do tej opowieści Douga P: . I often return to this story by Doug Patt, in which he quotes Edmund Bacon: “It’s in the doing that the idea comes.” It is pretty much my motto for life.
Rozumiem ją bardzo praktycznie: możemy z: I understand it in a very practical way: we can start with only the outline of an idea. Something interests us, there is something we want to test, and we make a first attempt. Only then do we notice possibilities we could not see before. A sketch, a conversation or a prototype gives us something to respond to. The next step becomes easier.
Często przypominam sobie te słowa, kiedy: I often remind myself of those words when I try to work everything out in advance. They give me the freedom to start with something imperfect and see where it takes me. After all, doing is part of coming up with ideas.

Bacon zajmował się projektowaniem całych: Bacon designed whole sections of the city, but this one idea resonates with me in much smaller matters too, even everyday ones.
